chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Texas hotels and Harry James at Waco
summary: Lists hotels they played in Houston, Galveston and Fort Worth and meeting Harry James in Waco.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Where did you go from the Gunner (phonetic spelling); do you remember?
From the Gunner,--
Baker?
No, that fell through.
We were going into Baker.
The Plaza I'm talking
The Plaza came in after the Gunner, but not directly after. We made a long tour before we--
They never had you guys play out at that beach resort out there--where Pet Kelly and all them used to play, outside of Houston?
No.
You played Houston; didn't you?
Yes, we played the Rice Hotel.
You did play the Rice Hotel?
Oh, yes. We played the Rice Hotel and Henry Buzzy was on one of the wings.
He had his own band by this time?
Yes.
What was that other
We played the Galvez, we Played the Galvez Hotel in Galveston.
Silver Beach; did you ever play the Silver Beach?
In Texas?
Yes, it's a summer resort.
Played Silver Beach in New York State.
That's upstate New York?
Yes.
That was after you were already up in this area?
Yes.
You played Galveston; how about Fort Worth, Did you play Fort Worth?
Yeah, we played Fort Worth Hotel.
You played just about every damn leading--
It was the biggest hotel in Forth Worth.
In other words, you played all the major cities?
Yeah, that's where I met Harry James.
Oh yeah?
In Waco--Hotel Waco. That's where I met Harry James. Harry James is from Waco.
He must have just been starting out then.
He was, because I didn't recognize the name until way later, when he got famous and I said I'll be darned, this is the guy that we met at the Hotel Waco.
